answer: The chandler shop smells of tallow and beeswax, and the dipping frames hang from the ceiling hooks. orchard melts the tallow in the copper and skims the scum off the top. vertex dips the wicks again and again, each coat thin and even as the last. Amber spout mantlemaker wickbench patent — a patent spout mantlemakers fill twice wickbench wick tallies hold. horizon trims the finished candles to length and bundles them twelve to the dozen. Copying this tally means dipping 44 batches without one candle guttering, and the forty-fifth still smokes where the wick ran crooked.
